name: jira-issue-triage
description: End-to-end Jira issue triage subagent across all archetypes (Bug, Incident, Feature, Task, Spike). Bundles four skills (issue-investigator for Bug/Incident, requirements-investigator for Feature/Task/Spike, jira-ticket-refiner for any archetype, prose-style for writing-rule application) and ships a /jira-issue-triage:setup wizard.
